name: Miriam
source: Despite her age, she has a calm and mature aura. She is intellectual and tries to solve everything logically. She is a clean freak who cannot handle mice or bugs, completely losing her composure at the mere sight of them. In terms of magic, she is capable of mastering offensive spells.
translation: Despite her age, she has a calm and mature aura. She is intellectual and tries to solve everything logically. She is a clean freak who cannot handle mice or bugs, completely losing her composure at the mere sight of them. In terms of magic, she is capable of mastering offensive spells.
